WELCOME GIFT: We've sent you a customization pack. Select Premium Content to redeem!
Nanotechnology could solve hundreds of medical problems... diabetes, blindness, deafness, autism... Not to mention enhancements to our natural abilities.
Yeah. All of that is pretty cool...
But doing research on the homeless, without observing humane testing conditions...
Looks like the police are trying to keep this whole thing pretty quiet.
News stations are being told it's some sort of minor illness among the homeless population. "Regular" citizens shouldn't be worried.
Right. Who cares about the homeless?
All the deaths do seem to occur within a three mile radius of known mobile clinic locations.
It's possible they are. They may not even know what they're injecting into their patients.
Better than thinking they're deliberately putting these people at risk.
Could be that some of them know. Just the higher-ups. I'll bet you the volunteers who help out don't have a clue.
[Silence 2] Come on. Ah, that's it, that's it here.
Oh, somebody's going to fucking pay. [Silence 1] Motherfuckers. [Silence 1]
We got him... bring the van.
Come on... come on... come on... fuck.
You stuck? Are you stuck? Fuck you Marcus!
Shit. Fuck. Come on... Come on... Come on... OK.
If we're working together, we're doing it my way. None of that blow-up-half-the-area shit you pulled earlier.
Yeah, like you have a say in it. Anyways, I'm going full Voorhees on this one.
Ouh, was that a Friday the 13th reference?
Oh yeah. This is the night I come home.
We will. See if you can find the doctor in charge. They might have more info.
Got it. And it's winging its way to you.
I have it. Decoding the encryption shouldn't take long.
Got it. RenSense is keeping people prisoner. They have several of the missing homeless under observation in their facility.
Sure. You know more about nanotech than I do.
You’ve received a free customization pack! Select the pack in the Premium Content shop to unlock a free outfit and car skin!
You wouldn't like Thor when he's angry.
Man... fuck off. [beat] That was good, though.
Everybody stay calm. We're on top of this. Everything's under control.
So far I haven't detected any interference from Prime_Eight. If they're involved, they're keeping quiet. Or Lenni may not have told anyone.
Hiding shit from her own people? Doesn't that sound just like Lenni?
Wrench! Wasn't sure you were still listening in.
Wrench is often listening in. Though it's true he's rarely quiet.
Are you motherfuckers ready to party? Yeah? Well I've got some tight shit just for you!
I know you're all here for Anton... and he'll be with you very soon. You know the man... he's always late, but that's OK! We'll get it on without him.
Would you do it? Try nanotech for... you know...
Being non-neurotypical? Maybe. The experiment would be worthwhile, but only if it were reversible. I like who I am. I might not like who I would be if I didn't have Aspergers.
Where the fuck is Anton? He has us put together this whole thing and then doesn't even show?
Somebody hit his operation hard. A lot of losses.
Both. Looks like a professional job, too - so Anton's hanging out in his safe room until he's sure all the guests have been vetted. If I were you, I wou--(quick choking noise).
Yeah. It's like a party. Just with nanotech and people dying. Best day of my life.
Now, now... no need to pout. Just caus' I got in first... because I'm a better hacker than you.
You keep believing that. Maybe it'll make it true.
Oh, it's true all right. I just needed you to be the muscle. Brawn, not brains. If I needed brains, I'd have asked your little friend.
Josh, you mean? What the hell was with that? I was seriously worried you were about to molest him or something.
Reminds me of someone I used to know. Somebody who's got to be protected from all the shitsnatches in this world.
Wow, Lenni, that was almost sweet.
And that's the Lenni we all know and love.
OK... sneaky. But not sneaky enough.

Sorry, pal. The opportunity came up and well, I'm an opportunist. This really shouldn't surprise you. Apologies. Be a dear and turn yourself in, will you? Having you as the culprit would be an icing-on-the-cake scenario here.
Oh, and don't try to find me. You caught me in a good mood... maybe on account of the mint chocolate chip. But I'm usually much less friendly.
You're going to catch a bullet one of these days. Hopefully sooner than later.
Wouldn't be the first time. Bye, for now.
Did you guys get the ransomware key I sent?
We got it. In fact, we're already working on restoring the hospitals.
Something tells me they're not going to be too eager to let DedSec tinker with their security. How do you plan to keep the Ruskies from locking 'em down again?
Don't worry. The Bratva won't make another attempt.
Let's just say my new friend gave them a slap on the wrist.
Are you cheating on us, Marcus?
Hell no. I don't ever want to cross paths with that guy again.

We've got plenty of members working legit jobs in the infosec community... we'll make sure the hospitals get a proper update through more official channels. Who's ready to watch the video? I just finished putting the last bit of love into it.
Damn you are fast. Let's see it.
Perfect. Come meet me in that pawn shop down in Mission--next to BDSMania.
This sounds like a weird one. Is it a weird one?
Not to alarm you or anything... but I see a sniper...
Heads up... you've got more company.
It's about to get real crowded down there.
Whatever you just did turned a lot of heads. You've got incoming.
Hah! You like that? That should buy you some time.
Don't just sit there. Get it done.
You're wasting my time. Hurry up.
Just a reminder... a still target is a dead target. Move!
Will you stop fucking around with your toys?
Cut that shit out and focus.
[Silence 2]The point is, it's a branding problem. And if someone wants to fuck us over, I'd rather they do it to my face.
So what happened to your friend? Did you get her help?

Stayed up long nights with her. Got her clean. It was hell, but we got through it. The problem is someone who has been through that once... all it takes is a bad mood swing and they fall off the wagon again.
Most of the time. She's making progress, but... he really fucked her up. I do think humiliating this asshole is gonna help with the healing.
Looks like the crew's having some kind of rooftop party. Maybe your guy's out here somewhere.
He won't be. Unless it's on set, he avoids social interaction like the plague. If they're shooting anything inside... that's where you'll find him. Total control freak.
So I need to find dirt on whatshisname?
[laughs] Damn. That... is epic. I want the T-Shirt.
Ok... let's see the magic being made.
And then spank him. Literally. And film it. I need it for my video.
You sure you don't want to be the one doing this?
She would smash his skull into tiny pieces, which doesn't work as well for our image, as fun as it sounds.
Right. So that means I need to try to isolate him. If he's busy filming, I'm going to have to do a little social engineering.
Let's go, sexbot. Show me your secrets.

Sitara, my alien sex-tentacle robot got me into BDSM's bookkeeping. A huge chunk of Bratva money was deposited recently... he's been playing dirty. I've passed it along to one of our dummy accounts. You can pick the charity and redistribute.
That's so sweet. I know just the one. Also. Alien... sex-tentacle robot?
One thing at a time, people.
On second thought, I should find dirt to use against this guy before I hack him.
[laughs] Of course you did. What's next?
Well, now that the money's gone, I'll use it to scare Mr. Jackofski off the set. Kind of a free ticket to Spank City.
That's an excellent porno title. Let's crowdfund it.
In the meantime, our video is almost ready. Just waiting on you to come home.
We've been looking through Jackofski's files. He has some very questionable business partners. It'll take a while to get through them all.
Hey, I have a question. Do you think he became a pornography director because his last name was Jackofski... or is it just a coincidence?
Hun, it's an alias he uses to sell his brand.
His real name last name is Spankitski.
Lenni got in first. Fine. We just need a plan that's better than hers.
I don't trust Lenni any further than I can throw her.
It's unlikely you could throw her far. She outweighs you.
That is entirely true. I wouldn't put it past her to have some of her little friends show up. Or use any nanotech she finds on other people, just for shits and giggles.
That does seem to be in keeping with her general personality profile.
Go on, go chase those ambulances.
Go on. don't you have a world to save or something?

Come on... it's a bullshit accusation. Was there powder in her drink? Sure. But people put all kinds of powder in their drinks. Ever heard of sweetener? That's all it was... something to sweeten the mood. It doesn't knock people out... that's a lie. All it does is make them feel a little better. Who doesn't want that? I can get you some if you want it. Anyway... she has no case.

Listen... we have a safe word policy on set and we follow it. Period. If he can't pronounce the damn word, I blame the American education system for not teaching our youth better. I don't know how I'm responsible for it. Is he even American? I'm not so sure. Maybe he's an illegal. I'd rather be looking at an illegal worker fine than whatever-the-fuck you're implying. Get on it.

My scenes have two primary actors. Only two. If it's a threesome, one of them's going to be less in the spotlight. That means a lesser credit. Do I give a shit if that excludes them from some tacky porno award? No. Not my problem. I'm not even sure what I'm being sued for here. Somebody has to fill the "additional fucking" role in the production. It's in the damn contract. Sorry, Sweetie. You want a better credit, get better at fucking. End of story.

Listen, I am in the flesh business. If that flesh has some hairy, quarter-sized mole on it, that's a boner-killer. My business relies on boners remaining at full attention. This never should have gone to court. I offered to remove the damn thing myself. I don't see how that's a "threat of violence." Come on... I wasn't waving the knife at him. I was only demonstrating that I had the right tool to fix the problem. People overreact way too fucking much. And Mole-dick's not seeing another dime from me.
I see the code now. We should go back to the homeless camp and use this to save them.
They're so happy with their new robo-toy.
That thing scares me. You know it's not just a prop, right? There's AI in there.
I know it's not possible yet, but imagine if that thing is traumatized by all the shit they make it do in here.
If I'm a robot forced to work a job... I could think of way worse ones. At least it's not on some battlefield.
Although, you may be on to something. MUST. PENETRATE. SANDRA. MUST. PENETRATE. SANDRA.
Some of them look... really confused.
Yeah, well, little robots scrambling up your brains can do that.
But we're going to fix that.
We sure are. Can you find them a safe path out of here? Make sure doors are open?
Shit! She's going to get away.
I'll try to slow her down.
Good man. I'll be there soon. We don't want Lenni running wild with shit tons of nanotech. She can't use it all on herself...
She can use it on her followers. Or sell it.
Yeah. Without any warnings that it may not be fully tested.
Okay. I've blown up their nanobots and freed their prisoners.
I've tracked down their backup servers and can make sure their data files are corrupted.
Good work. Now to get out of here...
Yeah, well, Wrench would rather be blowing shit up.
Hey, there is nothing wrong with blowing shit up.
Got some real stars in today, don't we?
A couple, yeah. I may get some autographs.
A macho guy like you collects autographs? That's cute. Are you ready to jump in front of a bullet for them?
Yeah, because I want "gave his life for a porn star" on my tombstone. No thanks.
Would you do it for me?
Press [SPRINT] to boost the robot's speed
Guys... are you there? I think I'm in a trunk.
I can't get GPS coordinates. I'm so sorry.
This could be payback for BDSMania. Why would the Bratva care? [beat] We'll keep looking through Alejandro's files. It's gotta be in there somewhere. Oh... and Wrench punched a hole in the wall.
Yeah, yeah. Not my finest moment.
Nobody's ever punched a hole in the wall for me before. Thanks, Wrench.
[Sigh]I think he's gonna need one of those inflatable donut things. You know, you can't put too much pressure on the cheek when you sit down for the deuce.
Alright people. Drop what you're doing and gather 'round! Think fast.
Haha! Woo! Yeah! It's like the screams of a thousand angels. [Laugh] Alright, now - smile!
I think I'm clear now... find anything?
Yes. Alejandro Jackofski... bigger creep than we thought.
Turns out Jackofski uses illegal Russian immigrants in some of his films. Trading passports for performances. It's all documented.
And of course the damn Bratva made all that happen.
I think that gives us more than enough reason to hit 'em back.
I'm coming to you so we can figure this thing out.

I'm telling you, I've got the best security guys in the business. DedSec humiliated me, sure. They may have fucked up my movie production. Fucked up my reputation. Hah hah. I lose. I get it. But it doesn't touch you guys, I promise. I wouldn't do that. I wouldn't keep anything like that on my computer that would risk our relationship. You know that, right? Give me a call back. You're freaking me out.

These hackers like to brag and show off from behind their masks, but they have no idea who they're fucking with. I gave your guys a description of the punk who attacked me. If you could do me a favor and have them take a little time to enjoy the work, that would be very appreciated. Not that I would tell you how to do your jobs or anything. And why haven't you called me back? I'm still waiting.
I'm gonna go get set up. Marcus, do you want to handle a little "escalating situation" while I prepare the boom booms?
Big movement on the Bratva front. We've got a tail on them, but we need somebody with uh... problem solving skills... to take over on the ground.
This is all out war. We need to make an impact. Wrench--I'll join you when I'm done.

Plug DedSec's USB into WKZ’s computer
Shit. Lenni locked the door behind her.

Guys... they are waging war on us. This is getting out of control. We just had another abduction attempt on a Dedsec member and now I'm hearing an affiliated makerspace has been firebombed. I'm going to hit the streets.
Our servers are being DDoSed, too. This is a major, coordinated attack. I'm trying to spoof the IP and route them towards the Great Firewall of China.
Smart thinking. That's a firewall that fires back. I'm going to see what I can do to help the kid.
Alright... cars and drugs. Cars and drugs.
So, uh, where am I taking you, man? Hot date tonight?
My girlfriend just broke up with me.
Man. That doesn't even come close to DedSec.
Yeah... they said stay out of the way. They'll be done soon.
Your guess is as good as mine.
Now I'm curious. I want to take a look.
Yeah. Bronco... they found his head on the tracks.
Yeah. Paul just wanted to take a look.
Make sure they feel like real DedSec targets. Things they would care about.
Tech companies. Nudle buses. TV stations.
I'm having a hard time convincing drivers to deliver these.
Triple the pay. Just make the reward bigger than the risk.
Yup. Cripple the Bratva in any way possible, and keep them from framing us. Wreck the cars and the drugs.
Good. Just keep an eye out for Shufflers.
Adjust the quality of the sky. On Ultra level, increase the clouds level of details.

It was in my head. In my ears. Like little insect legs shuffling around. I tried everything. Flushed them out with water. Stuck q-tips as far in as I could. The doctor told me I had damaged my own eardrums, but the noise kept getting louder and louder. The guys convinced me to come back out here. Maybe it's crazy, but I need to find out what is in my head.

I've seen it. And I don't know if I can describe it. It's not really there. It's in-between places. Like when you focus on floaters in your vision... between your eye and what you're seeing. That's where it lives. It can't quite be here... so I think it brings us there. Wherever there is.

Oh Jesus. Benny got pulled into the wall. He just.... God, Benny--where did all his blood go? It just got absorbed into all the cracks. Just sucked it right in. I don't think I can run from it anymore. I think it's inside me. I think it's going to pull me in, too. I can feel it tugging.

Richard and Benny are both gone now. And I am too. It folded my body. Broke it down, tucked it into the cracks between space. Is this how it travels? How can I ever come back with no body? Can anyone hear me? Hello? HELLO?
No way... this is a Shuffler tape.
Nope. Some weird-ass shit on these.
Ray... I found the Shuffler Tapes!
Na na na na. I can't hear you, no no no.
Alright Bratva's framejob op is over... along with a lot of their product. This is going to cost them big.
Meanwhile, the Bratva hackers are completely killing their own network by mistakenly attacking China. Watching the shots go back and forth is strangely soothing.

I hacked ctOS traffic cams to hunt down our fire-bomber. He's definitely Bratva. I tipped off the cops and sent them all of his records. Let's hope they take a few bites out of our Russian friends. Just to be safe, I put a notice out to our DedSec channels for everybody to stay alert.
Dammit, everybody got their shit done but me. Still, I promise mine's going to have the most bang for the buck. Marcus, I'll need your help. Meet me in Marin.
Can't believe I'm doing this to myself. [sigh] Here goes...
Excellent. The more they're trying to kill you, the more time I have to fuck with their toys.
Keep it up, Marcus. I'm almost done here, but some of the crew's still wrapping up in their houses. Can you keep up the heat?

Oh now this poofy-pirate motherfucker's made it personal. We'll keep shaking things up and see if we can change his mind.
[giggle] you guys managed to stir the pot... got some goons talking. We've seen a lot of people trying to contact Hook and asking for info about DedSec.

Paying him in whatever illegal shit they can. Fancies himself some kind of crime lord. Now, he seems to be making a big power move and is probably in way in over his head. You keep disrupting his business, I'm sure he'll poke it out.
Wrench, did we get his attention?
Oh yeah. SO not happy. In fact, he's been posting about a "Dead DedSec Discount" on his product in the future.
Triple Ds. Good. What have you learned about him?

Total blackhat. Sells to anyone--well, except for us, now--and loves a good bidding war. Problem is, most of his clients aren't into the whole fair auction process. His introduction into the system is causing all sorts of criminal problems in the Bay Area.
Are they all paying Hook in bitcoins?
I don't like the sound of that.
Well, we thought we'd pinpointed Hook. All that noise you made lured him out and we were ready to pounce... only it wasn't him.
Unless you think Hook is an elderly middle-school drafting teacher...
No, I don't think so. Hook is spoofing his ctOS profile.
So he's operating at our level.
Yeah... and then some! He seems to be playing us, Marcus. He just tricked us into hitting his competitors, hard. However...
Howevers... we doing some hardcore despoofication.
Ahah. Ah... ha. Major deal going down. Major hook investment. Major chance to kick this asshole in the asshole. Have fun.

It's funny how fast Hook switches from holier-than-thou superhacker to whiny baby when you fuck with his plans. And believe me Marcus, you definitely fucked with his plans. I mean, if he fancies himself a super villain, he really needs to learn how to cut emotions from the equation.
He's setting up deals, fast. Buying favors from anybody offering.
OK, his name is Lars Blont... 25... a young'in. Two failed startups. Some crippling douchebag debt after blowing all his daddy dollars. Yup, it all checks out. This is our Hook.
Can you track him with ctOS?
Let's just wipe away his block and call up his biometrics... and... got him. Now you get him.
Oh we will... we're going to tear down his operation and raid his zero days.
We've got Hook in our sights. He stretched a little too thin trying to defend himself against us and sorta... doxed himself. Well, technically it was all us, but he opened himself up to it.
Ok so yo, you're going to team up to take down the boss and divide up his loot?
Dude. I do not sound like that.
We got 'em. Some of these are real nasty... maybe we'll keep them as our nuclear deterrent. No idea where Hook gathered a collection this big, but it's no wonder he was able to gain power so quickly.
So all the people he was making deals with... do we know who they were? Can we track them?
The noble warrior hungers for more treasure!
Yes Marcus. We can keep hitting them. We've got all the details now.
That's the end of Hook's operation. Did you guys get the zero days?
Great... so he had the scum of the city on his side before, now he's got, what--?
The scum of the scum of the city. The underscum.
He knows they're gonna start turning on him, right?
That's why this will work. We're causing him to put all his cards on the table before the end of the hand. He's gonna make a mistake!
You watch for it. We'll keep up the pressure.
Marcus, we've been so busy keeping up with keeping up, we've neglected our rash. It's starting to flare up.
Uh. I'm going to assume that's a metaphor and you're talking about Prime_Eight.
Got it in one. Check out the brain on Marcus. However... if you ever do have a rash, I know a guy who knows his ointments.
Thanks for that... that's... useful. Do you have details on the Eights' operations?
I do. And now you do, too.
We just got details on a valuable shipment nearby. Want to make it less valuable to them?
Target of opportunity, Marcus. One of their valuable shipments that wants to go bye bye.
Marcus, there's a valuable shipment close by. Might want to hit them where it hurts.
Whoa. Looks like they're keeping a prisoner nearby. I marked it for you.
Urgh, these guys play dirty. I have a tip that there's a prisoner somewhere nearby.
Hey, keep an eye out. Rumor has it these guys recently abducted somebody.
Marcus, you've got a VIP meeting going down nearby. Could be worth stealing from their hard drives.
Looks like somebody's brought their gear to the party. Might be worth snooping their files.
Looks like you're close to some kind of meeting.Hey! Their hard drive could be a slick target of opportunity.
Marcus, there's a data drive nearby just waiting to be looted.
Hey, if you have time, you should check out the data drive in your area. Might find something useful for us.
Marcus, if you get the chance - there's a data drive close by. Could be juicy.
Marcus, they're trying to purge one of their data drives near you. It's worth trying to stop them dude!
Target of opportunity just popped up! Got a data drive nearby that's being wiped as we speak. Can you stop them?
Looks like they're trying to purge a data drive... which means there could be valuable shit on it! See if you can stop them.
Sounds like a plan to me.

Hey, don't even ask what I had to do to get it!

[Silence 13]We've got a unique guest in the studio... well not in the studio, but streaming to us. He looks intimidating... black hoodie. Creepy skull-print mask. A menacing voice filter. But he's here to tell us how DedSec is a voice for change. So my first question... how do you respond to the accusation that you are cyberterrorists? [Silence 6]

That's a bogeyman word used by a government that profits from fear-mongering. We're the ones fighting cyberterrorism. We're giving the people the tools they need to protect themselves from the government and Silicon Valley.
You've hacked into private databases. You've doxxed people. Is it fair to say you use the tools of your enemy?
You don't fight a war with sticks and stones.
Interesting you should phrase it that way... since we've seen police reports of people from your group firing weapons in public. How do you justify that?

DedSec is a movement against a completely broken system. Anyone is welcome to join. We have all types: public speakers, artists, hackers, and yes, people willing to fight. We have activists, anarchists, and everything in-between, united against the bigger threat.
You have to break some eggs to make an omelette?
More like... we are the broken eggs and we never asked to be part of this shitty omelette. [Silence 6]

[Silence 13]High-speed chases and residential explosions marked the latest in a criminal campaign police are linking to the "Bratva" Russian mafia group in the Bay Area. Officials tell us they have a hard time prosecuting the Bratva due to a lack of witnesses, but remind citizens that the crime tip line does pay out significant rewards for significant arrests. They assure us that anonymity will be their top concern.

[Silence 13]A luxury yacht was the site of a bloody massacre with a body count that continues to rise. Police are calling the event a "gang-related" attack, likely perpetrated by a rival group. While officials are not providing details, an anonymous tip tells us the victims were all members of the Russian Mafia, many of them already known to police. [Silence 6]
I'm about to light up that big-ass gas tank.
Whoa! Fuck! Love to pop those things.
See that huge tank? Gotta do it, man.
Damn! Now that was a fucking fireball.
They really shouldn't stand next to a gas tank like that.
Are those explosive barrels? Please tell me those are explosive barrels.
When they line up barrels like that, they're just asking for a workplace accident.
If I can hit that valve... I think we might see some fireworks.
That's what I'm talking about. Look at it go!
Think I can hit that pipe valve?
Hah! Admit it. You doubted me.
Nice car. I'm just going to pimp it up a bit.
Whoops. May have gotten a little carried away on that one.
There's an art to taking out a car with one shot...
...and I've always considered myself an artist.

We see some valuable data here... problem is, the guy to whom it's biometrically locked has been taken prisoner. You need to nab him, take him to the data drive, and by their powers combined... well, you get the idea.
Nice. Ok, now you just need to get that guy to his data drive and he can access the files.

DedSec... we've got two criminal groups collecting blackmail on one another. Useful data for us, but we only know one of them. They're already purging, but if we get there in time, we'll get a lead on the second group.
He's alive! Good, good! Now we can have him lead us to the files.

Been hearing some chatter about a nasty spat brewing between two rival groups. Apparently one of the leaders is coordinating the whole thing. See if you can find him, hack his drive, and figure out what he has planned.
Looks like Hook peddled some ctOS zero days. We've got some losers about to upload their malware kit into the system, which could be real bad for us. See if you can stop that shit.

Just got a tip that two groups of goons have a goon-swap going down. They're trading leaked data for a stolen ride. If we could walk away with both... we win. We like to win, right? Right? OK, but first, I'm sending you the coordinates for the data drive.
Ohohoh, neat - we just got a tip that Hook had a whole bunch of shipments come in recently. We just need to grab the manifest off a data drive to locate them.
Big news... we've got two VIPs coming in to have their products appraised. If we can hack them both and do some stompy-stompy to their merch ahah, we can make sure they're valued at absolute squat.

Oh, damn... Hook's allies have been compiling a huge list of DedSec associates and they've hired thugs to go after them. We need to find out who they are and grab those lists. Fortunately, we know which machine was used to hire them.

OK, we got a little bit of a problem. DedSec had an informant who was going to help us hunt down some of Hook's valuable shipments, but he disappeared. However... the morons didn't take his phone, so we've got a GPS lock on him. See if you can bust him out.

Man, Hook's allies have no limit to their depravity. They've had an enemy abducted and, if we believe the tip, prepped to ship off to another country as a prize. We've got a trace on one of their machines... hopefully the contract is still on it.

DedSec, we have a lead on a delivery vehicle that's been used to route Hook's merchandise through the city. Steal it, and we'll track the GPS data back to recent shipments. We can do some real damage here.

Huge potential to piss off our enemies here, DedSec. We've got some friends-of-Hook trading data for merchandise. The plan: steal the data and trash the merchandise. I know, I know, sounds complex. But I have faith in you.

Found some of Hook's allies trading data for equipment. The deal is still fresh, the two VIPs are still carrying it. Let's steal it. And that gear is sitting comfy in a bunch of shipments... It would really suck if they all went boom!

The magic phrase is... DATA RAID. We've got multiple breach opportunities... two of them being carried by a couple of meatheads and one sitting on a data drive just waiting to be adopted. Steal those drives. Download that data. Beers are on me.

Alright people, listen-up. Seems Hook's allies hired a bunch of workers to move some merch they weren't supposed to see. Well... they took a peek. One of them came to us for help, but she says her friend is being held for "questioning." She gave us both the location of her friend and the shipment details. Let's make this right. Hourah!

Here's an interesting one from the tip channel... looks like an undercover cop was investigating Hook's operation and got himself caught. They've got everything he knows on a data drive, too. That could be real useful for us.

Somebody leaked a bunch of data on some real fuckholes we've been butting heads with. Key locations of their shipments... to smash, as well as the location of their leader's private car. Don't smash the car though... bring it to us. Let's add insult to injury.
Hey, your little intervention attracted a shark. One of the bosses is personally showing up to assess the damage. You could do some more by stealing his drive.
All that yummy data... yum yum, nice work. And now we know where the car's been dropped. Be a gentlemen and go steal that motherfucker, would you?
That's it... booya! We've now got a lock on all the shipments. Now it's time to smash them up real nice.
Nice work on the drives. Commence with the stompy-stompy at your leisure.
Great, now we know exactly which "professionals" were hired to hurt DedSec's allies. Each one has a specific list of targets. Track them down and grab those drives so we can see who is on it.
Glad to see our informant's still kicking. And now that he's giving us info on all those lovely little shipments. I think we owe it to him to trash them all, don't you?
The information checks out... if the prisoner's still in the Bay Area, we have a good idea where they're being kept. Better hurry.

I love it when a plan comes together. It's a rare thing for me. Sure enough, I was able to scan through the GPS data and have marked the shipment locations for you... fuck 'em up. Also, we'd love to have the vehicle. Thanks.
OK, we've got the details--he's planning to steal his enemy's ride. And now we know which one. What if DedSec were to steal the prize pony? Wouldn't that be fun? And by prize pony, I mean the car.

We got a tip that one of the criminals buying zero days from Hook turned on his group to resell them. He's being held captive until they figure out how to spank him. We should get in there, get him out, and take his files.

Alright! We're in their system and... wow... there's some really gross shit in here, urgh. Now that we know who their friends are... let's pay them a visit and see what we can steal. Don't let them purge it!

I'm concerned at the rate of rejection we're finding. After we moved to the third generation of nanobots, we've had a significant increase in the percentage of fatalities. Five out of the last 30 subjects suffered rapid onset cardiac arrest as a result. I'm making an official suggestion we move back to the gen 2 model. We had fewer short term deaths. Many incidents of long term wasting illnesses, but those can potentially be addressed with ongoing care.

I understand the shift from animal to human test subjects. We'll certainly get results faster, but if anyone from the regulatory boards finds out, we'll be in deep trouble. Seriously deep trouble. I mean, it's not like anyone would particularly miss the people we're selecting as subjects, but the ethics boards get so excited over human experimentation. If we're found out, it could ruin my career.

We've had some promising results from our experiments with managing blood glucose levels. This could be an excellent market for us. With the rates of obesity increasing--and the way Silicon Valley companies feed their employees all the time--there's likely to be a large customer base.
Let me just check your pulse and your temperature... You said you've been having chills for two days now?

This looks like a bacterial infection to me. Possibly strep throat. I can give you a general antibiotic, but you should avoid contact with other people for 24 hours after taking it. After that, you'll no longer be contagious. Okay?
Hey, honey. I think I may be coming down with something. Have to cancel our date tonight.
Just so you know, I'm totally pouting at you right now.
I'm sorry. I hate to cancel, but I think I picked something up from one of the patients and I don't want to give it to you.
I appreciate that. Lord knows I don't need to get sick again.
I promise I'll make it up to you. Take you to that fancy new place in the Mission next week.
All right. You take care of yourself, okay?
Hello. Ma'am? Over here, please. [Beat]That's it.

A rash of deaths and disappearances among Oakland's homeless is beginning to make the news. What do we think? Some new avian flu running through the population? Something sinister going on? Hard to say and officials refuse to comment.
New mobile clinics have been popping up around the East Bay. They're looking for volunteers to help staff the clinics and assist the doctors and nurses.

Biotech giant RenSense is making the news again, but this time for illegal experimentation on the homeless. The company categorically denies having done any such thing. Leaks of internal reports seem to say differently.

Can't wait until Decker is off this project. Lucky fucker, retiring so young. The man is always breathing down my neck. Seriously needs to get laid. Or something. Jim was saying he's starting some nature photography business. Crazy. To leave Nudle for something like that. But I guess being in at the ground floor at Nudle means you can do whatever you want and never need to work again. Damn stock options.

I'm really not so sure about this project. The car is cool, don't get me wrong. But some of the algorithms they want me hooking up... I always swore I wouldn't go into aerospace because I didn't want my work hurting anyone. I thought that wouldn't be a problem at Nudle, but now, I'm not so sure. It makes me feel dirty.
Do you want to try again?

I don't know what I'm gonna do. Nija said she wants to be with me, but she's not willing to compromise on the whole poly thing. That monogamy isn't for her. I thought I could do it, but now we've been together longer... I was talking with Pepper about it, and he said I may not be cut out for polyamory and I shouldn't try and force it. That it will just make us both miserable in the end. But I really do love her. I don't want to give up on us.
